empty.waiting: Nobody is waiting for your answer
empty.waiting_sub: A conversation appears here when a client asks for a person, when the bot suggests reply variants, or when a payment has to be checked.
empty.none_sub: They appear when clients write to a connected channel.

howto.title: How to get reply variants from the bot
howto.one: For one client: open the conversation and choose «Bot suggests, I send» at the top.
howto.all: For every client of a channel: in Settings → Channels open the channel and turn on «The bot suggests replies, a person sends them».

inbox.pick_sub: Here you will see the messages and can answer the client.
inbox.sandbox_readonly: This is a test conversation from the sandbox. Here you can only read it.

who.label: Who answers
who.bot_hint: The bot answers the client itself. You see the conversation and can step in at any moment.
who.suggest_hint: The bot prepares reply variants and sends nothing itself. You pick one, edit it if you wish, and send.
who.me_hint: The bot is silent. Only you answer this client.
who.suggest_done: The bot will now suggest replies
who.me_done: The bot is silent, you answer
who.channel_locked: In this channel the bot only suggests replies in every conversation. This is changed in Settings → Channels.
who.channel_link: So the whole channel is set up — change

compose.bot_note: The bot keeps answering after your message. To make it silent, choose «Only me» at the top.
compose.suggest_note: When the client writes, the bot's reply variants appear here.
compose.me_note: The bot is silent while you answer.

side.no_scenario: No scenario is going on now: the bot just answers questions.
